description: Discover available AI models with numeric IDs, tier labels, capabilities, and per-call pricing in sats. Call this before create_payment to find the right modelId for your task. Returns JSON array: [{ id, name, tier, description, price, isDefault, category }]. Models marked isDefault=true are used when you omit modelId from create_payment. Filter by category to narrow results to a specific tool. This tool is free, requires no payment, and is idempotent — safe to call repeatedly.

category.description: Filter by service category (matches tool names)

name: list_models
